name: Al-Farabi
shortBio: Known in the Islamic philosophical tradition as 'The Second Teacher' (after Aristotle), Al-Farabi pioneered Islamic political philosophy, formal logic, and metaphysics.
centralQuestion: How can philosophy and prophetic revelation cooperate to establish the virtuous city and lead humanity toward true happiness?

keyWorks.title: The Virtuous City (Al-Madina al-Fadila)
keyWorks.description: Political treatise synthesizing Plato's Republic and Aristotle's Politics within an Islamic cosmological framework.

keyWorks.title: The Book of Letters (Kitab al-Huruf)
keyWorks.description: Foundational commentary on Aristotle's Metaphysics, linguistic philosophy, and ontology.
